author: Yffe
content: Built forge/src/body_tv.rs — the body-state TV check phase, sibling to forge::exec_tv. Wired the forge body-tv verb in cli.rs + main.rs, added the spec-route, set both design REQ-5 statuses SHIPPED. Tests forge/tests/body_tv.rs: faithful straight-line->Faithful, faithful while->Faithful, mutated->Divergent, binary_search loop->Skipped, all live verus.
